A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MePo research work. All 19 pages of each version, including figures, tables, Algorithm 1 and Appendices A-D, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MePo benchmark experiments, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, runtime measurements and representation visualizations in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix C, including benchmark comparisons, ablations and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same pseudo-task construction, sequential and joint meta-learning updates, meta covariance initialization, Cholesky alignment and feature combination. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both retain CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R and CUB-200, plus the appendix evaluations on NCH, GTSRB, Core50 and DomainNet. Pretraining-data coverage and the Si-Blurry, offline, online and domain continual-learning scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Seq FT, Linear Probe, Seq FT (SL), CODA-P, Deep L2P, DualPrompt, MVP and MISA with the same MePo comparisons. The OML comparison and comparator membership in the appendix experiments also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both specify the same five-phase Si-Blurry setup with disjoint-class ratio 50% and blurry-sample ratio 10%, ViT-B/16 checkpoints, evaluation metrics and training settings. Appendix protocols, including batch-size and task-length variations, are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both contain the same Meta Rep/Meta Cov ablations, alpha sensitivity, batch-size, pretraining-data and pseudo-task-count analyses, OOD tests and representation visualizations. These remain in Table 2, Figures 5-9 and Appendix C without added or removed analyses.

E5.justification: Tables 1 and 2 retain five runs with different task sequences and mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty reporting in the appendix are also unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and empirical visualizations are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 reports the same ImageNet-R results for MISA with MePo under Sup-21/1K: AAUC 64.23 ± 1.30 and ALast 58.20 ± 0.51.

T1.justification: The problem formulation and optimization/alignment equations are unchanged. Appendix D retains the same Sequential Update Consistency Theorem, assumptions, derivations and proof; equation placement changes do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty and contribution claims: preparing pretrained models for rehearsal-free GCL through Meta Rep and Meta Cov, with transferable performance gains and limited downstream overhead.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations involving sequential drift, reference covariance, component complementarity, feature sparsity and stability-plasticity tradeoffs. No substantive limitation, applicability qualification or interpretation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same sampling details, optimizers, learning rates, regularization and GPU/CPU specifications. Runtime and data-budget information and the code link are unchanged; the new acknowledgment does not revise implementation or access instructions.

R1.justification: The cited works, Appendix A discussion and positioning relative to prior CL/GCL and meta-learning methods are unchanged. References shift across pages following the acknowledgment insertion, without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v3 adds a funding and institutional acknowledgment on page 9, revises the Tsinghua-Peking affiliation wording, replaces the preprint footer with an ICML/PMLR publication notice and adds terminal punctuation to the abstract. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Publication-footer and acknowledgment changes cause localized text reflow, small shifts in equation and Figure 3 placement, and reference redistribution across pages 9-11. Figures 1-9 and Tables 1-12 retain their content and design; pages 5-8 and all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v3 adds publication information and acknowledgments with minor editorial and layout adjustments. The methods, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, interpretations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the complete appendices. These administrative additions do not materially change the paper's scientific support or clarity.
